Lemma
[Smooth Sections Through a Prescribed Basis]

Let $V\to B$ have rank $m$, let $x_0\in B$, and let $(w_1,\ldots ,w_m)$ be a basis of $V_{x_0}$. There are an open neighborhood $v$ of $x_0$ and sections $Y_j$ smooth on $v$ with $Y_j|_{x_0}=w_j$.

Proof

\sketch In a local trivialization $\Phi $, set

\[ Y_j|_x=\Phi _x^{-1}(\Phi _{x_0}(w_j)). \]

These sections are constant in trivialized coordinates.

□
